exitCodes.2: usage error, or --project is not a directory
exitCodes.3: no capability map (not an error); stdout is {"schemaVersion":1,"error":"no-capability-map"}
exitCodes.4: capability map or a module file unreadable; stdout is {"schemaVersion":1,"error":"unreadable","detail":...}

review.none: no review marker in the file (the project may not use markers); says nothing about approval
review.pending: written and waiting for the user's review
review.approved: approved by the user; the file has not changed since
review.revised: Spec only: approved earlier, edited after approval, needs another review
review.invalid: the marker line is malformed; review state unknown

externalReview.none: no external review recorded and not declined
externalReview.recorded: an external review (for example from delegate) is recorded; advisory only, not an approval
externalReview.declined: the user declined an external review for this module
